verdict.rationale: Poly has its own tag system: Poly tags sync both ways with Finder tags, colors included, and tags are kept on import. Nothing in the evidence shows typed properties (structured fields with data types) or tag-based filtering and retrieval. Missing for 10: typed properties on notes or files, filtering or search by tag or property, any tag-management documentation beyond Finder sync, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can attach typed properties and tags to notes and use them consistently for organization and retrieval

citations.quote: Tags & colors: Finder tags sync bidirectionally with Poly tags, colors included.
Metadata such as tags and colors are preserved
